WITH matched_fees AS (
  SELECT o.mktnote, f.feerate - f.rebrate AS net_fee_rate
  FROM fees AS f
  JOIN orders AS o
    ON o.recordvault = f.orderslink
), pair_averages AS (
  SELECT mktnote, AVG(net_fee_rate) AS avg_net_fee_rate
  FROM matched_fees
  GROUP BY mktnote
), overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(net_fee_rate) AS avg_net_fee_rate
  FROM matched_fees
), above_overall AS (
  SELECT p.avg_net_fee_rate, p.avg_net_fee_rate - a.avg_net_fee_rate AS excess
  FROM pair_averages AS p
  CROSS JOIN overall_average AS a
  WHERE p.avg_net_fee_rate > a.avg_net_fee_rate
)
SELECT AVG(avg_net_fee_rate) AS mean_pair_average_net_fee_rate,
       AVG(excess) AS mean_excess_over_overall_average
FROM above_overall;
